prompt: Create a polished 16:9 effect board showing two distinct IMAGE2 UI product screens side by side. The left screen is a design-system catalog only, with compact title, search, filters, quiet counts, slim cards, miniature component previews, and one Preview action. The right screen is a design-system laboratory only, with design-system tabs, a single/compare view switch, settings button and open settings drawer, plus a canvas occupying about 80 percent of the workspace. Preserve the restrained white, cool-gray, black, and signal-green tool language. No old six-control toolbar, component-row lists, count bubbles, chat overlays, gradients, glassmorphism, oversized hero, or marketing composition.
